title: Horizon Network and Horizon Media Group merge to form HN Group
summary: Horizon Network and Horizon Media Group have merged to form HN Group, with HN Group Limited as the group’s parent company from 1 September 2026. All staff move to HN Group.
body:
Horizon Network and Horizon Media Group have merged to form HN Group, with effect from 1 September 2026. HN Group Limited, incorporated on that date, is the new parent company of the group.

The ownership of HN Group

HN Group Limited is owned by Charlie Livsey and Jack Vinckx, as recorded on the HN Group Company Register:
• Charlie Livsey holds 75% of the shares (Class C), with 95.24% of the votes.
• Jack Vinckx holds 15% of the shares (Class B), with 4.76% of the votes.
The remaining 10% of the shares have not been issued.

The companies in the group

• Horizon Media Group Limited is wholly owned by HN Group Limited.
• Horizon Network Limited is 50% owned by HN Group Limited, which holds voting control (58.82% of the votes). Charlie Livsey holds 30% and Jack Vinckx 20%.
• Horizon Advertising Limited is owned equally by Horizon Media Group and Horizon Network, so it also forms part of HN Group.

Horizon Network and Horizon Media Group continue as companies in their own right, keeping their names, brands, subsidiaries and the services they provide.

Our people

From 1 September 2026, all staff and employees of Horizon Network and Horizon Media Group, and their staff contracts, have moved to HN Group Limited. Everyone keeps their existing terms, role and length of service, and now works across the group for HN Group.

The merger agreement

The full merger agreement is attached to this announcement as a PDF. Shareholdings are as recorded on the HN Group Company Register at companies.hngroup.org.uk.
author: HN Group
